title: Multiplication by a coordinate sign
statement: Let $q$ be any real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates. The Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the function $x\mapsto q(x)x_i$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $q$ at the symmetric difference of $S$ and $\{i\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
